question: is the mu(I) dip and the 16-57 % offset of round 22 a realisation artefact or a device property?
reference: archived da Cruz 2005 Eq. (13)/(14): mu = 0.22 + 1.00 I, phi = 0.81 - 0.30 I, valid for I <= 0.2

predictions.P2_dip: the I=0.03 -> 0.1 decrease survives the ensemble (median paired delta < 0 and disjoint 95 % CIs)
predictions.P3_bias: ensemble mean mu outside the 10 % band at I = 0.03 and 0.1
predictions.P4_friction: mu increases with mu_contact; at I = 0.03 the ladder does not reach the 10 % band around 0.25

decision_rules.P1: CV <= 0.10 -> one realisation resolves the band
decision_rules.P2: dip is systematic if the paired differences are all negative and the mean change is more than 2 standard errors from zero
decision_rules.P3: outside the band if |mean/law - 1| > 10 % and the 95 % CI of the mean excludes the law value
